crew.overview: In war-torn colonial America, in the midst of a bloody battle between British, the French and Native American allies, the aristocratic daughter of a British Colonel and her party are captured by a group of Huron warriors. Fortunately, a group of three Mohican trappers comes to their rescue.
crew.title: The Last of the Mohicans

details.biography: Cody Frost is an American bullrider and PBR livestock superintendent. He is a seven-time NFR bull riding qualifier, three-time NFR saddle bronc rider and veteran of three PBR Finals. Frost is the younger brother of legendary American bullrider Lane Frost.
details.name: Cody Frost
